en: Black-and-white view through tall conifer trees onto a valley with a large multi‑story villa or guesthouse. The building has a small corner tower, wooden balconies and half‑timbered details. A narrow road and bridge cross a stream in front. Hills with scattered houses and forest rise in the background. On the façade and a roadside sign the name of the establishment is visible.
